title: 7-Day Course Outline
summary: 7-Day Staff Teamwork Training Programme. Theme: building a respectful, cooperative, responsible and high-performing team. 45–60 minutes daily.

sections.title: 7-Day Staff Teamwork Training Programme
paragraphs: Theme: Building a Respectful, Cooperative, Responsible and High-Performing Team.
Duration: 7 days. Daily training: 45–60 minutes. Participants: all Zura Spa staff.
Training format: teaching, practical examples, role-play, discussions and daily assignments.

items.label: Day 01
items.body: Understanding Teamwork and the Zura Team Culture

items.label: Day 02
items.body: Respect, Professionalism and Workplace Relationships

items.label: Day 03
items.body: Effective Communication and Active Listening

items.label: Day 04
items.body: Emotional Intelligence, Humility and Accepting Corrections

items.label: Day 05
items.body: Conflict Resolution and Handling Difficult Situations

items.label: Day 06
items.body: Accountability, Reliability and Supporting Colleagues

items.label: Day 07
items.body: Building a Winning Team: Practical Assessment and Commitment

sections.title: Training Objectives
paragraphs: By the end of the seven days, every staff member should understand how to work effectively with others, communicate respectfully, accept corrections, resolve disagreements, take responsibility, and contribute to a healthy working environment.
By the end of the seven days, every staff member should understand how to:
list: Contribute to a healthy working environment.

sections.title: Module 1 — Day 1: Understanding Teamwork and the Zura Team Culture
paragraphs: Objective: Understand what teamwork means and why individual behaviour affects the entire organisation.
list: Difference between working together and simply working in the same place.
How individual attitudes affect team performance.
Putting team success above personal ego.

items.label: Activity
items.body: Each staff member identifies three behaviours that strengthen a team and three that weaken it.

items.label: Assignment
items.body: Write five ways you can personally make Zura a better workplace.

sections.closing: Open the five lessons below in order. Complete each lesson, then do the Day 1 activity and assignment.

sections.title: Module 2 — Day 2: Respect, Professionalism and Workplace Relationships
paragraphs: Objective: Learn to treat every colleague with dignity regardless of position, personality or differences.
list: Avoiding gossip, mockery, cliques and unhealthy competition.
Being courteous even when you disagree.
Separating personal feelings from professional responsibilities.

items.label: Activity
items.body: Discuss workplace scenarios involving disrespect, exclusion and gossip.

items.label: Assignment
items.body: Demonstrate three deliberate acts of respect toward colleagues during your shift.

links.label: Read We Are Not Friends, We Are Not Family Standard

sections.closing: Open the Day 2 lessons below in order. Complete each lesson, then do the Day 2 activity and assignment.

sections.title: Module 3 — Day 3: Effective Communication and Active Listening
paragraphs: Objective: Develop clear, respectful and professional communication habits.
list: Speaking politely and choosing appropriate words.
Understanding tone, facial expressions and body language.
Asking questions instead of making assumptions.
Communicating concerns to the right person.
Appropriate communication in staff WhatsApp groups.

items.label: Activity
items.body: Role-play a misunderstanding between two staff members and demonstrate a better communication approach.

items.label: Assignment
items.body: Practise active listening and document one situation where it improved communication.

sections.closing: Open the Day 3 lessons below in order. Complete each lesson, then do the Day 3 activity and assignment.

sections.title: Module 4 — Day 4: Emotional Intelligence, Humility and Accepting Corrections
paragraphs: Objective: Learn to manage emotions, receive feedback constructively and respond maturely.
list: Understanding the difference between correction and personal attack.

items.label: Activity
items.body: A supervisor corrects a staff member for failing to prepare a massage room properly. Participants demonstrate constructive and unconstructive responses.

items.label: Assignment
items.body: Identify two areas where you need improvement and how you intend to work on them.

sections.closing: Open the Day 4 lessons below in order. Complete each lesson, then do the Day 4 activity and assignment.

sections.title: Module 5 — Day 5: Conflict Resolution and Handling Difficult Situations
paragraphs: Objective: Resolve disagreements professionally without damaging working relationships.
list: Addressing issues instead of attacking personalities.
Avoiding gossip, retaliation and taking sides.
Knowing when to involve a supervisor.

items.label: Activity
items.body: Two therapists disagree over room preparation and shift responsibilities. Participants practise resolving the matter fairly.

items.label: Assignment
items.body: Write the steps you would take to resolve a disagreement with a colleague.

sections.closing: Open the Day 5 lessons below in order. Complete each lesson, then do the Day 5 activity and assignment.

sections.title: Module 6 — Day 6: Accountability, Reliability and Supporting Colleagues
paragraphs: Objective: Develop a sense of responsibility and commitment to collective success.
list: Helping colleagues without neglecting personal responsibilities.
Reporting mistakes promptly rather than concealing them.

items.label: Activity
items.body: Simulate a busy spa shift with multiple bookings, delayed room preparation and staff needing assistance.

items.label: Assignment
items.body: Identify one improvement you can make to your daily responsibilities that will benefit the entire team.

sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The staff member owns their duties, reports mistakes promptly, and supports colleagues without dropping their own work.

sections.title: Module 7 — Day 7: Building a Winning Team — Practical Assessment and Commitment
paragraphs: Objective: Demonstrate the lessons learned and commit to improved workplace behaviour.
list: Understanding the qualities of an excellent Zura team member.
Applying teamwork principles to everyday spa operations.

items.label: Activity
items.body: Team members participate in a simulated workday involving customer requests, changing schedules, misunderstandings and shared responsibilities.

items.label: Final assignment
items.body: Each participant submits a personal teamwork improvement plan with five measurable commitments.

sections.closing: Learning Outcome: The staff member can apply the week's lessons on a live shift and commit to five measurable teamwork improvements.

sections.title: Assessment and Completion
paragraphs: Staff should be evaluated on both knowledge and practical behaviour.
Recommended passing score: 75%, followed by a 30-day workplace behaviour review.

sections.title: Supplementary Learning
paragraphs: For supplementary learning, staff can take the free eight-hour Working in Groups and Teams course from The Open University. It covers team roles, trust, conflict and performance evaluation, and offers a free statement of participation.

This seven-day outline is a Zura-specific training programme, not the official syllabus of the Open University course. It can serve as the foundation for a complete staff training manual, with daily lessons, real-life scenarios, quizzes, answers and facilitator instructions.

remember: Team success comes before personal ego. Practise the day's lesson on the floor, complete the assignment, and treat every colleague with respect.
